title: Background motion type payload
description: Payload of video_re_detect_background_motion_type: per shot, whether the picture is static, a still moved by pan/zoom (Ken Burns), rendered procedural motion, camera footage, or footage that loops, with the measurements behind the call.

raw_frame_diff.description: median mean abs grey difference between consecutive frames (0-255)

residual_after_compensation.description: same after warping by the fitted pan/zoom

rigid_share.description: share of textured blocks that follow one similarity motion

pan_fw_per_s.description: content motion in frame widths/heights per second

zoom_per_s.description: natural-log scale change per second, positive = zoom in

hf_energy_fraction.description: share of spatial power above 0.03 cycles/px in a middle frame

palette_concentration.description: share of pixels in the 8 most common 4-bit colours
